news.title: Nvidia’s Chinese Clients Will Get Just 1% of $70 Billion in RTX Chip Orders
news.summary: Key TakeawaysChinese AI and cloud firms, Alibaba among them, have ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips worth about $70 billion, but expect to get only about 1% of them over the next four months. With too little capacity to go around, NVIDIA is building its most advanced, higher-margin chips first, so China’s orders are left waiting.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要中國 AI 與雲端企業（包括阿里巴巴）已訂購約 6 million 顆 NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 晶片，價值約 $70 billion，但預期未來四個月僅能獲得其中約 1%。因產能不足，NVIDIA 優先生產最先進、利潤較高的晶片，導致中國訂單被迫等待。

news.title: Netflix (NASDAQ:NFLX) CFO Sells $612,085.95 in Stock
news.summary: Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX - Get Free Report) CFO Spencer Neumann sold 9,253 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, November 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $66.15, for a total transaction of $612,085.95. news.summary: Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX - Get Free Report) CEO Theodore Sarandos sold 27,312 shares of the company's stock in a transaction on Wednesday, November 4th. news.title: Bill Ackman: Netflix “an Incredibly Cheap Stock” After a 55% Drop. But Is He Right?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman called Netflix “an incredibly cheap stock” on CNBC’s Squawk Pod, after his fund sold out of most of its Alphabet stake and with Netflix down about 55% from its June 2025 high. Ackman says viewing hours are falling because Netflix’s content mix is changing, and Netflix’s churn improved year over year in the third quarter.

news.title: In 1975, Sol Price Was Pushed Out of FedMart, the Discount Chain He Founded. The Warehouse Store He Opened Next Became Part of Costco

news.title: “The Next Trillion Dollar Company”: Marvell Is Up 82% in 2026. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell is up 82% in 2026, even after losing about half its value since its June high. NVIDIA’s $2 billion investment, Jensen Huang’s trillion-dollar call and 46% data center growth last quarter drove the run.
news.title_zh: 「下一家兆元公司」：Marvell 上漲 82% 在 2026。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Marvell 上漲 82% 在 2026，即使自六月高點以來已跌去約一半價值。輝達的 $2 billion 投資、黃仁勳的兆元呼聲以及 46% 資料中心上季成長推高了股價。

news.title: This Short Seller Flagged Jensen Huang’s Ties to Alice Huang 6 Months Before Nvidia’s Scandal
news.summary: Wall Street shrugged off a short seller's warning about Jensen Huang and a Singapore chip buyer. Then the board opened an investigation, and the report's bigger claims about China and Megaspeed started to look like the real threat.
news.title_zh: 這名做空者在輝達醜聞爆發前 6 個月就指出黃仁勳與 Alice Huang 的關係
news.summary_zh: 華爾街無視一名做空者關於黃仁勳與新加坡晶片買家的警告。隨後董事會展開調查，報告中關於中國和 Megaspeed 的更大指控開始看起來才是真正威脅。

news.title: Nvidia and Jensen Huang Just Got Sued by Shareholders Over His Ties to a Suspected Spy
news.summary: A shareholder lawsuit landed minutes after the closing bell, accusing Nvidia of hiding a CEO's link to a suspected Chinese spy. The stock was already sliding, and the real danger may not be the courtroom at all.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 和黃仁勳剛因其與疑似間諜的關係被股東起訴
news.summary_zh: 股東訴訟在收盤鐘聲響起幾分鐘後提起，指控 Nvidia 隱瞞 CEO 與疑似中國間諜的關係。股價已經下滑，真正的危險可能根本不在法庭上。

news.title: 1 Year Ago, Jensen Huang Said, “China Is Going To Win The AI Race.” Now Nvidia’s Board Is Investigating His Relationship With An Alleged Chinese Intelligence Asset
news.summary: Jensen Huang spent a year lobbying Washington to reopen the China chip market, and now his own board wants answers. Two separate storylines reveal how deeply Beijing shapes Nvidia's fortunes, and what could be at stake when Congress calls on Nov. 18.
news.title_zh: 1 年前，黃仁勳說：「中國將贏得 AI 競賽。」現在 Nvidia 董事會正在調查他與涉嫌中國情報資產的關係
news.summary_zh: 黃仁勳花了一年時間遊說華盛頓重新開放中國晶片市場，現在他自己的董事會想要答案。兩條獨立的故事線揭示北京如何深度塑造 Nvidia 的命運，以及當國會傳喚 Nov. 18 時可能面臨什麼風險。

news.title: NVIDIA Falls 4% as Board Probe of Jensen Huang Weighs on Shares; AMD and Broadcom Gain 3%
news.summary: NVIDIA is posting record growth, yet its stock keeps sliding while rivals climb. A board investigation into its CEO has split the chip sector, and one upcoming event could decide which side of the divide investors land on.
news.title_zh: NVIDIA 股價下跌 4%，董事會調查黃仁勳拖累股價；AMD 和博通上漲 3%
news.summary_zh: NVIDIA 呈現創紀錄增長，但其股價持續下滑，而競爭對手卻上漲。董事會對其 CEO 的調查分裂了晶片板塊，即將到來的事件可能決定投資者站在哪一方。

news.title: AMD vs. Intel: Which Is the Better Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chip Stock to Buy Right Now?
news.summary: Both companies have been experiencing solid growth in their data center businesses, but one of them seems like the better bet.
news.title_zh: AMD 對決 Intel：哪一檔是現在買進較好的 AI 晶片股？
news.summary_zh: 兩家公司的資料中心業務都經歷穩固增長，但其中一家似乎是較好的押注。

news.title: AMD Just Guided to More Revenue Than Intel. A Decade Ago Intel Was 12x Its Size
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD expects about $17 billion of revenue in the fourth quarter, above Intel’s $15 billion to $16 billion forecast. In the third quarter of 2016, Intel’s revenue was about 12x AMD’s.
news.title_zh: AMD 營收指引超越 Intel。十年前 Intel 是 12x 其規模
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 預期第四季營收約 $17 billion，高於 Intel 的 $15 billion to $16 billion 預測。在 2016 年第三季，Intel 營收約為 AMD 的 12x。

news.title: Google, Nvidia, AMD And Others To Invest $26B In Anthropic Alongside IPO
news.summary: The private placement also includes Broadcom, Micron Technology, Microsoft, and TSMC Partners.
news.title_zh: Google、Nvidia、AMD 等將投資 $26B 於 Anthropic，配合 IPO
news.summary_zh: 私募配售亦包含 Broadcom、Micron Technology、Microsoft 及 TSMC Partners。

news.title: US Stock Futures Mixed As Investors Await CPI Data — AMD, CRWV, RKLB Stocks In Focus
news.summary: Oil prices continued to decline as easing concerns about a potential U.S. military strike on Iran reduced fears of supply disruptions.
news.title_zh: 美國股指期貨走勢不一，投資者靜待 CPI 數據 —— AMD、CRWV、RKLB 股票受關注
news.summary_zh: 油價持續下跌，因對美國可能襲擊伊朗的擔憂緩解，減輕了供應中斷的恐慌。

news.title: Nvidia “Hasn’t Really Had to Worry About Competition” for Four Years. AMD Is Closing In
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD rose Monday as Nvidia fell on a board inquiry involving CEO Jensen Huang. AMD’s data center sales are a tenth of Nvidia’s, but AMD expects 2027 revenue to grow more than 80%, faster than analysts expect from Nvidia.
news.title_zh: Nvidia「四年來無需真正擔心競爭」。AMD 正在追趕
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 週一上漲，而 Nvidia 因涉及 CEO 黃仁勳的董事會調查而下跌。AMD 的資料中心銷售額是 Nvidia 的十分之一，但 AMD 預期 2027 營收增長將超過 80%，快於分析師對 Nvidia 的預期。

news.title: A $28 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAxiom Investors opened an AMD stake, added 48% to GE Vernova and built up Lumentum in the June quarter. All three have fallen at least 23%, while AMD and GE Vernova’s average analyst targets still sit far above their prices.
news.title_zh: 一家 $28 Billion 基金買入了這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 Axiom Investors 在六月季建立 AMD 部位，增持 48% GE Vernova 並加碼 Lumentum。三檔股票均下跌至少 23%，而 AMD 和 GE Vernova 的平均分析師目標價仍遠高於其股價。

news.title: AMD Stock Clocks Best Day In 6 Months — But Michael Burry Won’t Touch The Nvidia Headline Trade
news.summary: Burry trimmed 25% of his SMH puts last week but retained substantial bearish semiconductor exposure.
news.title_zh: AMD 股價創 6 個月最佳單日表現 —— 但 Michael Burry 不碰 Nvidia 頭條交易
news.summary_zh: Burry 上週減碼 25% 其 SMH 賣權，但保留大量看空半導體部位。

news.title: The AI Trade Looks Like It's Falling Apart. AMD's Earnings Delivered a Reality Check.
news.summary: AMD is still growing and is optimistic about the fourth quarter, despite recent market noise about the AI trade.
news.title_zh: AI交易看起來正在崩盤。AMD財報帶來現實檢驗。
news.summary_zh: 儘管近期市場對AI交易有雜音，AMD仍在增長並對第四季持樂觀態度。

news.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 9: AMD Jumps on Oppenheimer Upgrade and Google Cloud Chip Selection
news.summary: Today, Nov. 9, 2026, shares of AI-focused chip designers faced a crucial week as investors weigh data-center demand ahead of next week's sector earnings.
news.title_zh: 今日股市，Nov. 9：AMD因Oppenheimer升級評級和Google Cloud晶片選擇而飆升
news.summary_zh: 今日，Nov. 9, 2026，專注AI的晶片設計商股票面臨關鍵週，投資者在下週行業財報前權衡數據中心需求。

news.title: Lisa Su Called the Market ‘Short-Sighted’ as AMD Crashed 17%. Two Sessions Later the Stock Has It All Back
news.summary: AMD added nearly $100 billion in market value Monday on an Oppenheimer upgrade and a Google Cloud win, two sessions after Lisa Su called the market short-sighted during a 17% crash. For a retiree holding 1,000 shares bought at $55.94 in 2022, here is what the day was worth, what AMD's own history says comes next, and the tax bill on three ways to trim a $452,640 gain.
news.title_zh: Lisa Su稱市場「短視」時AMD暴跌17%。兩個交易日後股價全數收復
news.summary_zh: AMD週一因Oppenheimer升級評級和Google Cloud獲勝，市值增加近$100 billion，這距離Lisa Su在17%暴跌期間稱市場短視僅兩個交易日。對於持有1,000股、於2022以$55.94買入的退休者，以下是當天的價值、AMD歷史預示的後續走勢，以及三種減碼$452,640獲利的稅單。

news.title: AMD Soars 12% on “Undeniable” Data Center Success per Oppenheimer Upgrade
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 12% today after Oppenheimer upgraded the stock to Outperform with a $600 target. Broadcom and GE Vernova also rose in a broad AI infrastructure rebound.
news.title_zh: AMD因Oppenheimer升級評級，以「不可否認」的數據中心成功而飆升12%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要AMD股價今日跳升12%，因Oppenheimer將評級上調至跑贏大盤，目標價$600。Broadcom和GE Vernova也在廣泛的AI基礎設施反彈中上漲。

news.title: The Real Winner of Google’s $135 Billion Chip Forecast: Broadcom
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGoogle unveiled two new versions of its TPUs today, and Bloomberg Intelligence expects TPU sales to grow from about $12 billion this year to more than $135 billion by 2028. Broadcom helps design the TPUs and has a deal to supply them and their networking through as late as 2031, so it has far more riding on that forecast than Alphabet does.

news.title: Nvidia Gets the Spotlight, but This AI Stock Could Steal the Show in 2027

news.summary_zh: 當 Nvidia 佔據頭條時，Broadcom 悄悄打造讓 OpenAI 和 Google 繞過 GPU 的客製化晶片。該股票今年表現跌跌撞撞，但一個 2027 佈局可能迅速扭轉劇情。需要什麼條件？

news.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. news.title: Only One Analyst Rates Oracle a Sell. What Does the Lone Bear See?
news.summary: Oracle keeps beating earnings estimates and Wall Street keeps cheering, yet the stock has slid hard this year. The lone skeptic points to a number that the bulls rarely mention, and it may explain why the market refuses to follow the consensus.
news.title_zh: 僅一位分析師將 Oracle 評為賣出。這位孤獨的空頭看到了什麼？
news.summary_zh: Oracle 持續超越盈餘預期，華爾街持續歡呼，但股價今年卻大幅下滑。這位孤獨的質疑者指出了一個多頭鮮少提及的數字，這可能解釋為何市場拒絕跟隨共識。

news.title: Oracle Lost a $7 Billion Tencent Deal and a Microsoft Contract in 3 Days: Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI capacity from Oracle, two days after Oracle reportedly scrapped a $7 billion chip lease with Tencent. Oracle raised about $20 billion in stock and notes, using its entire funding cap through fiscal 2030 within five days of setting it.
news.title_zh: Oracle 失去一筆 $7 Billion 騰訊交易和一份微軟合約，耗時 3 天：賣出，還是加碼？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟正在結束一筆 2023 向 Oracle 租用 AI 產能的交易，這是在 Oracle 據報取消與騰訊的 $7 billion 晶片租賃協議兩天後。Oracle 透過股票和票據籌集了約 $20 billion，在設定後五天內用盡了截至財政 2030 的整個融資上限。

news.title: Alphabet, Meta, and Oracle Are All Teaming Up to Disrupt Nvidia's Biggest Competitive Advantage
news.summary: The biggest factor locking customers into Nvidia chips -- the dominance of its proprietary CUDA software platform -- is under threat.
news.title_zh: Alphabet、Meta 和 Oracle 皆聯手打擊輝達最大競爭優勢
news.summary_zh: 將客戶鎖定在輝達晶片的最大因素——其專有 CUDA 軟體平台的主導地位——正面臨威脅。

news.title: Alphabet, Amazon and Meta Haven’t Bought Back a Share in 2026. Big Tech Buybacks Fell 90%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCombined buybacks at Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle fell to $4. 4 billion in the third quarter, 90% below their late-2021 peak, according to a tally by The Kobeissi Letter.
news.title_zh: Alphabet、亞馬遜和 Meta 在 2026 皆未回購一股。大型科技股回購下降 90%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet、亞馬遜、微軟、Meta 和 Oracle 的合併回購額降至 $4。4 billion 在第三季，較其晚期-2021 高點低 90%，據 The Kobeissi Letter 統計。

news.title: The Stock Market Is “Petrified of Oracle’s Balance Sheet” as Microsoft Walks Away
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a deal to rent AI computing power from Oracle, days after Oracle canceled an estimated $7 billion chip-leasing deal with Tencent. The Microsoft contract itself looks small, but losing it leaves Oracle’s backlog leaning even harder on OpenAI, which S&P says accounts for about half of it.
news.title_zh: 股市「懼怕甲骨文資產負債表」 微軟撤資
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟正結束向甲骨文租用 AI 算力的協議，此前幾天甲骨文取消了估計 $7 billion 晶片租賃協議。微軟合約本身規模不大，但失去它使甲骨文的積壓訂單更加依賴 OpenAI，標普表示佔其約一半。

news.title: Microsoft Borrows at “10 Percentage Points Below CoreWeave.” Now It’s Backing Away From Neoclouds
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft wants fewer neocloud partners and won’t renew one of its cloud contracts with Oracle, CNBC reported on Friday. Citi’s Steven Wieting says Microsoft’s cost of debt is about 10 percentage points below CoreWeave’s.
news.title_zh: 微軟以「10 Percentage Points 低於 CoreWeave」借款。如今它正遠離新雲端
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：據 CNBC 週五報導，微軟想要較少的新雲端合作夥伴，且不會續約其一項與 Oracle 的雲端合約。花旗的 Steven Wieting 表示，微軟的債務成本約為 10 percentage points 低於 CoreWeave。

news.title: Microsoft reportedly winds down Oracle AI infrastructure contract
news.summary: Originally announced in 2023, the partnership provided Microsoft with access to Oracle servers to operate an AI-supported edition of its Bing search engine.
news.title_zh: 據報微軟正逐步終止甲骨文 AI 基礎設施合約
news.summary_zh: 該合作原於 2023 宣佈，讓微軟得以使用甲骨文伺服器，運行具 AI 功能的 Bing 搜尋引擎版本。

news.title: IREN Says New AI Cloud Customers Are Prepaying 90% of the Chips
news.summary: A customer just agreed to fund nearly all of IREN's chips upfront, yet cash is draining and debt is climbing fast. Why would anyone pay that much early, and what does it reveal about the $6 billion gap still unfunded?
news.title_zh: IREN 表示新 AI 雲端客戶預付 90% 的晶片款項
news.summary_zh: 一位客戶剛同意預先資助 IREN 幾乎所有的晶片，但現金正在流失，債務卻快速攀升。為什麼有人願意那麼早支付那麼多，這揭示了關於 $6 billion 仍未獲資助缺口的什麼信息？

news.title: Iren: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
news.summary: Older H100 GPU contracts were recently renewed at double their original price, a sign that demand for existing hardware is holding up.
news.title_zh: Iren：3 給長期投資者的關鍵要點
news.summary_zh: 較舊的 H100 GPU 合約最近以雙倍原價續約，顯示現有硬體需求持續強勁。

news.title: IREN Shares Surge 18% After Strong AI Cloud Revenue Growth and Better-Than-Expected Quarterly Results
news.summary: IREN Ltd (NASDAQ:IREN) shares jumped 18. 1% in premarket trading on Friday after the artificial intelligence infrastructure company reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, helping the stock recover from a sharp decline in the previous session.
news.title_zh: IREN 股價飆升 18%，強勁 AI 雲端營收增長與優於預期的季度業績
news.summary_zh: IREN Ltd (NASDAQ:IREN) 股價跳升 18。1% 在週五盤前交易中，這家人工智慧基礎設施公司報告的財年第一季 2027 業績超過華爾街預期，幫助股價從前一交易日的急跌中恢復。

news.title: IREN Moves Its $4 Billion AI Cloud Goal Into 2027, With $6 Billion of Capex Yet to Be Financed
news.summary: The bitcoin miner turned AI cloud provider blamed a customer-requested change and supplier timing for the delay, as AI cloud revenue rose to $200 million last quarter.
news.title_zh: IREN 將其 $4 Billion AI 雲端目標推遲至 2027，尚有 $6 Billion 資本支出待融資
news.summary_zh: 這家比特幣礦商轉型的 AI 雲端供應商將延遲歸咎於客戶要求的變更和供應商時程，而 AI 雲端營收上季增至 $200 million。

news.title: What IREN (IREN) Said on Its Q1 Earnings Call
news.summary: IREN (NASDAQ:IREN) reported a nearly threefold increase in AI Cloud revenue for its fiscal first quarter, but pushed back its target for bringing more than $4 billion of annualized operating revenue online, citing a customer-requested design change and supplier timing. Co-Founder and Co-CEO Daniel
